hotkey.hint: Press {{keys}} to bring up this window

log.title: Event log
log.settings_save_failed: Could not save the language setting
log.applied_remote: Put an item from another device on the clipboard
log.skipped_duplicate: Skipped: same as the last copy
log.apply_failed: Could not write to the clipboard
log.clipboard_monitor_failed: The clipboard monitor could not start

webview2.missing: The Microsoft Edge WebView2 runtime was not found, so OnePaste cannot show its window. Please install it and then start OnePaste again.

join.title: Join your vault
join.intro: Paste the connection code from the device that already holds your vault, and type its passphrase. The passphrase is used once and never saved.

errors.wrong_passphrase: The passphrase is wrong. Nothing was changed.
errors.vault_empty: This server has no vault yet. Create one first on a device that supports it, then join with its connection code.
errors.invalid_connection_code: This is not a valid connection code.
errors.unreachable: The server cannot be reached. Check the address and your network.
errors.registration_invalid: The connection code has expired or was already used. Ask for a new one.

join.note: The key stays in your system's secure store. The server only ever sees encrypted data.

paused.revoked: This device was removed from the vault, so syncing has stopped. Ask for a new connection code from another device and join again.
paused.server_rollback: The server shows older data than this device has already seen, so syncing has stopped. Use "onepaste resync" on the command line to recover.

queue.stuck: {{conflict}} changes are in conflict and {{failed}} could not be uploaded.

search.placeholder: Search your history (local index, never uploaded)

results.empty: Nothing yet. Copy some text or an image and it will appear here.

settings.title: Settings
settings.autoApply: Put what you copy on your other devices into this computer's clipboard
settings.record: Record what I copy on this computer
settings.privacyBody: Clipboard content never goes into logs or diagnostics. Diagnostics only list event kinds, sizes and error codes.
settings.aboutBody: OnePaste is source-available and free for non-commercial use. No telemetry is sent.

detail.title: Details
detail.none: Select an item to see its details.

devices.soon: The list of your other devices will appear here once the app can read it from the vault.
